name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - Prophecy Pack
summary:
New character skin and additions to the cat creator.
The Prophecy Pack gives you more options to enhance your Warrior Cats experience with additional content.

The Prophecy Pack includes:

• 8 Accessories to use in the cat creator

• 12 Wearable accessories

• Cel-shaded characters skin

• 4 cat poses for photo mode

• 4 photo mode effects
